Buffalo Hospital Supply Co., Inc.
distributes traditional medical-surgical equipment and consumables, but
it does not primarily focus on or specialize in selling or distributing consumer or digital
wearable medical devices
Company Overview
Founding Year:
1977
Headquarters:
Buffalo, New York, United States
What the Company Does:
It operates as a full-line medical-surgical distributor providing patient care items, diagnostic tools, laboratory products, x-ray equipment, physical therapy supplies, wound care, and surgical equipment to hospitals, nursing homes, and health agencies.
